# COCO-Bench v1

*Generated by `tools/r3/make_datasheets.py`; never edit by hand.*

Frozen benchmark suites for mobile-robot navigation in COCO Lab's kinematic model (MODEL), with paired Gazebo + Nav2 subsets (STACK) in `docs/v2/r3/`. One datasheet each:

| suite | family | scenarios | tiers (easy/medium/hard) | held-out per run | world |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`arena-nav-50`](arena-nav-50.md) | planning, control, localisation | 50 | 17/17/16 | 15 | coco_arena_v1 |
| [`ctrl-corners-30`](ctrl-corners-30.md) | control | 30 | 10/10/10 | 10 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`ctrl-corridor-30`](ctrl-corridor-30.md) | control | 30 | 10/10/10 | 10 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`ctrl-dynamic-30`](ctrl-dynamic-30.md) | control | 30 | 10/10/10 | 10 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`depot-clutter-50`](depot-clutter-50.md) | planning, control | 50 | 17/17/16 | 15 | coco_depot_clutter_v1 |
| [`depot-long-50`](depot-long-50.md) | planning, control | 50 | 17/17/16 | 15 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`depot-narrow-30`](depot-narrow-30.md) | planning, control | 30 | 10/10/10 | 10 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`depot-nav-100`](depot-nav-100.md) | planning, control, localisation | 100 | 34/33/33 | 20 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`loc-global-20`](loc-global-20.md) | localisation | 20 | 7/7/6 | 6 | coco_depot_v1 |
| [`loc-kidnap-20`](loc-kidnap-20.md) | localisation | 20 | 7/7/6 | 6 | coco_depot_v1 |

| [`task-fetch-10`](task-fetch-10.md) | fulltask | 10 | 4/3/3 | 0 | coco_depot_v1 + coco_depot_colours_v1 |

Run a suite in the browser (Workbench → Benchmarks) or natively: `coco experiment run` with `"scenarios": {"kind": "suite", "id": ID, "version": 1}`.
